fix(index): a re-read transcript drops a tool result that was only a recall block, as a rebuild does

Closes #5555

benchmarks.task_description:
Repair the integration contour after the native provider changes

The integration-tests job has been red on master since #4808 and #4821, which blocks every open pull request.

- `TestNativeBinarySchemaInspectBareFormatsStillRender`: native `schema inspect --format json` writes the desired model since #4808. The JSON case moves to `TestNativeBinarySchemaInspectJSONWritesTheDesiredModel`, which checks the shape instead of hashes that change with every model edit.
- `TestJSONDocumentsCarryAnUndecidedObjectE2E/schema_apply`: apply reports contract version 3 since #4821; the expectation was 2.
- `TestSchemaApplySkipsAnIndexCommentOnSpannerE2E`: `CaptureApplyPlan` dropped a trailing comment-only unit, which is where Spanner's skipped-object note is rendered. The note now rides on the preceding SQL unit. `TestCapturedApplyKeepsATrailingSkippedObjectNote` fails without the change.

Verified locally: unit contour, both golangci-lint contours, qtlint, teststyle, and the native inspect tests with `-tags integration`. The MySQL and Spanner e2e tests need their servers and run in CI.

benchmarks.task_description:
fix(postgres): retain concurrent migration failures

Retain advisory-lock query failures alongside concurrent cancellation so
consumers cannot mistake a database failure for a clean operator stop.
Preserve meaningful explicit rollback failures and discard uncertain
physical sessions when they are released.

Publish the correction as v3.2.2 without changing migration SQL, ledger
history, checkpoints, timeout defaults or retry policy. Focused public
backend regressions cover cancellation, mixed failures and cleanup.

Linear: DEVELOP-3838

fix(github): log why the alerts read was refused and retry it sooner

## Why

The Dependabot alerts read answers `unknown` on a 403 or 404 and says nothing, so an owner can't tell a missing permission from alerts switched off (https://github.com/alrayyes/forge-dashboard/issues/2452). Their App installation had a pending permission and every row stayed unknown.

## What

- Logs `dependency advisories refused` at warn level with the repo, the HTTP status and GitHub's message. Once per repo per change: the same refusal on the next read stays quiet, a different one is logged again. The token never appears.
- A refused answer is asked again after 5 minutes instead of 15, so a permission fixed on GitHub shows up sooner.

## Checked in the code

- A token change builds a new client (`Manager.Ensure` with fresh sources), so its advisory cache starts empty. A stale unknown does not survive a token change.
- An installation client reaches `ListRepoAlerts` fine: `restClient.Dependabot` is set by `ghsdk.NewClient`, and the base URL is applied to the client.
- The installation token is minted by ghinstallation and reused until it nears expiry. A permission accepted on GitHub later reaches the dashboard only when that token refreshes (up to about an hour), or on a Settings save or restart. That is the likely cause of unknown surviving a fix, and is documented in the follow-up.

## Tests

`go test ./internal/github ./internal/dashboard` passes; `golangci-lint` clean. New tests cover the log once per change and the 5 minute retry.

Refs https://github.com/alrayyes/forge-dashboard/issues/2452

fix(api): reject uploads without a file part as bad requests

## Why is this PR needed?

A valid multipart upload without the required `file` part returns HTTP 500 with `server_error`, hiding a request validation problem behind an internal failure.

## What does this PR do?

Map `http.ErrMissingFile` to HTTP 400 with `invalid_request_error` and a missing-file message, consistent with the existing missing-purpose validation.

## How was this tested?

The HTTP router regressions cover an absent file, a text-only `file` field, and a file uploaded under another field name. All three returned 500 before the fix and now return 400.

The file-handler package passes with the race detector. All apiserver packages, OpenAI error-model tests and changed-file pre-commit checks pass, including root-module unit tests, build, formatting and vet.

- [x] Unit tests added/updated/verified
- [ ] Integration/e2e tests added/updated/verified
- [ ] Manual testing performed

## Checklist

- [x] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) per [DCO](PR_SIGNOFF.md)
- [x] Code follows project [contributing guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] CI checks pass (`make ci`)
- [ ] E2E tests pass (`make test-e2e`)

## Related Issues

fix(lint): stop warning that SessionEnd takes no matcher

`LINT005` told users to drop a `SessionEnd` matcher that both tools read.

- Claude Code hooks (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks.md): "| `SessionEnd` | why the session ended | `clear`, `resume`, `logout`, `prompt_input_exit`, `other` |"
- Codex hooks (https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks.md): "| `SessionEnd` | end reason | Currently only `other` |"

Contradicted code: `internal/cli/native_capabilities.go:230` (`matcherAcceptingEvents` lacked `SessionEnd`) and `internal/adapters/codex/hooks_support.go:38` (`sourceMatchers` had no entry).

Changes:

- `SessionEnd` joins `matcherAcceptingEvents`.
- `"SessionEnd": {"other"}` joins the Codex `sourceMatchers`, so the Codex coverage check accepts `other` and still rejects Claude-only values such as `logout`.
- Tests: a lint test that failed before the fix, and three Codex `AcceptsHook` cases. The existing misuse test now uses `Stop`.
- `hook-reference.md` has no SessionEnd claim, so no docs change.

Checks: `go test ./internal/cli ./internal/adapters/codex` pass; `gofmt -l internal` clean. Full `make ci-local` not run; the change adds one set entry and one map entry, with no emitted output change.

Closes #2392
